steps.text: Speak to Lord Kandur in the house west of the Vinery (Xeric's Glade teleport on talisman).
chat: 2. Anything I can help you with?

steps.text: Speak to Chef Olivia in Lord Kandur's kitchen.
Head to the Arceuus Library (fairy ring code CIS, or games necklace to Wintertodt Camp, or Lovakengj Minecart Network to Arceuus) and speak to Galana. (north-east wing, )
Speak to Galana again. She will tell you where to find the Varlamore envoy book. This is random for everyone.

Enter the Crabclaw Caves, marked by the icon, south outside of the Woodcutting Guild near the water. Kill a sandcrab for easy diary while here. (Rada's blessing, Skills necklace teleport, Xeric's Talisman to Xeric's Look-Out, or Veos ship/charter ship to Land's End)
Navigate to the end of the caves and climb down the tunnel at the end.
Return to Lord Kandur Hosidius and talk to him.
